### Laboring a Few Days for Christ: How Great Loves Make Burdens Light
Author: Greg Morse
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/articles/laboring-a-few-days-for-christ
Passage: Genesis 29:20
Points:
- Jacob's deep love for Rachel made seven years of grueling labor feel like only a few days.
- A great love has the power to lift heavy burdens and reshape our perception of time.
- Wholehearted love for Christ transforms long, difficult seasons of Christian service into joyful endurance.
- When affections for the Savior cool, obedience and trials quickly become tedious and overwhelming.
- Christ first endured the cross for the joy of redeeming His bride, fueling our devotion in return.

### The Forgotten Woman
Author: Tedd Tripp
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/forgotten-woman
Passage: Genesis 29:25
Points:
- Jacob's morning realization that he had Leah reflects the disillusionment inherent in earthly longings.
- Spouses, careers, and worldly pleasures can never fully satisfy the deepest desires of the human heart.
- Leah spent years seeking Jacob's love and validation, naming her first three sons after her ache.
- True flourishing came when Leah turned her gaze from her husband to God and offered praise.
- God pours out sovereign grace on the unloved and forgotten, placing Leah in the lineage of the Savior.

### The Driving Force of Love
Author: Lysa TerKeurst
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/encouragement-for-today-march-28-2006-1386066.html
Passage: Genesis 29:20
Points:
- Jacob's profound love for Rachel gave him the focus and persistence to endure years of service.
- Biblical love is the foundational driving force required to sustain the Christian journey.
- Loving God with all of our heart enables persistent faith and trust during inevitable trials.
- Compassion for others empowers believers to set aside personal agendas to pursue the lost.
- Spiritual maturity looks beyond temporary comfort to serve Christ with delight and expectation.
